textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® x6000 Series, Pentium® and Celeron® Processors of 6th Generation ("Elkhart Lake")

The COM Express® Compact Module TQMxE40C2 offers a powerful computing solution with 6th Generation Intel Atom® processors, featuring dual/quad-core capabilities with clock speeds of up to 3.0 GHz. It supports up to 32 GB of DDR4 SO-DIMM memory with optional inband ECC for data reliability.

This module provides enhanced connectivity options, including 8 PCIe lanes (Gen3) and USB 3.1 Gen2 ports for high-speed data transfer. It boasts triple display support, allowing for versatile visual output with up to 4K screen resolution. Furthermore, its extended temperature range of -40°C to +85°C ensures reliable performance in challenging environments.

The TQMxE40C2 is part of the COM Express® Compact form factor (95 mm x 95 mm), making it suitable for various applications, such as industrial automation, transportation, and medical technology. It also incorporates Intel graphics processors, enabling support for up to three parallel displays.

With virtualization support and features like Time Coordinated Computing, this module is well-equipped for real-time applications and time-synchronous IoT solutions. The optional eMMC flash memory (up to 256 GB) and flexible assembly options for embedded DisplayPort (eDP) or LVDS offer customization possibilities.

The module includes an integrated board controller with thermal management and a multi-stage watchdog. With low power consumption and conformal coating options, the TQMxE40C2 is a robust and versatile choice for FPGA engineers seeking high-performance solutions in a compact form factor.

text.text:
Features

  • Dual/Quad-Core Intel Atom® Processors: Powerful processing capabilities for a range of applications.
  • Up to 32 GB DDR4 SO-DIMM Memory Support: Enhanced memory capacity for data-intensive tasks.
  • 8 PCIe Lanes (Gen3): High-speed data transfer and expandability options.
  • Triple Display Support with 4K Resolution: Versatile visual output for various display configurations.
  • Extended Temperature Range: Reliable performance in challenging environmental conditions.

CPU
  • Intel Atom® x6211E (2-Core, 1.3/3.0 GHz, 1.5 MB, 16 EU, Turbo, 6 W TDP)
  • Intel Atom® x6413E (4-Core, 1.5/3.0 GHz, 1.5 MB, 16 EU, Turbo, 9 W TDP)
  • Intel Atom® x6425E (4-Core, 2.0/3.0 GHz, 1.5 MB, 32 EU, Turbo, 12 W TDP)
  • Intel Atom® x6212RE (2-Core, 1.2 GHz, 1.5 MB, 16 EU, 24/7, RT, 6 W TDP)
  • Intel Atom® x6414RE (4-Core, 1.5 GHz, 1.5 MB, 16 EU, 24/7, RT, 9 W TDP)
  • Intel Atom® x6425RE (4-Core, 1.9 GHz, 1.5 MB, 32 EU, 24/7, RT, 12 W TDP)
  • Intel® Pentium® and Celeron® N and J Series processors on request
Memory
  • DDR4 - 8GB, 16 GB, 32GB (1 SO-DIMM)
  • EEPROM - 32kbit
  • eMMC - 8-256 GB
Graphics
  • 1x eDP (4K @ 60 Hz) or LVDS (18/24 bit)
  • 2x Digital Display Interface (DDI) for DP (4K @ 60 Hz)
Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 1x Gbit Ethernet
  • USB - 2x USB 3.1 | 8x USB 2.0
  • SATA - 1x  SATA 3.0 (up to 6 Gb/s)
  • Serial Port - 2x Serial Port
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 8x PCIe 3.0
  • LPC - LPC/eSPI
  • I2C
  • SMBus
  • SPI - SPI (for external UEFI BIOS flash)
  • Audio - Intel HD Audio
  • GPIO - 8x GPIO through TQ-flexiCFG
  • SD Card/GPIO - 1 SD Card/8x GPIO
General
  • Dimensions - 95mm x 95mm
  • Plug-in System - COM Express Compact, Type 6
  • Temperature range - Standard temperature: 0°C…+60°C (HE versions)
  • Power supply -  Main Voltage: 4.75 V - 20 V / Standby Voltage: 4.75 V - 5.25 V / RTC Battery Voltage: 3 V / Power: typ. 3 - 8 W/max. 14 W / (Green ECO-Off: < 0.1 W)
  • Power consumption - typ. 3 - 8 W/max. 14 W (Green ECO-Off: < 0.1 W)
